name: Tapioca Cream
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)

ingredients.item: ¼ cup pearl tapioca or 1½ tbsp Minute Tapioca

steps: Pick over tapioca and soak one hour in cold water to cover, drain, add to milk, and cook in double boiler until tapioca is transparent.
Add half the sugar to milk and remainder to egg yolks slightly beaten, and salt.
Combine by pouring hot mixture slowly on egg mixture, return to double boiler, and cook until it thickens.
Remove from range and add whites of eggs beaten stiff.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
